title: Zesty Charred Vietnamese Pork Bun Cha
description: A charred and silky Vietnamese dish featuring roasted peppers and pork, served with bun cha, a traditional Vietnamese vessel made of tagliere.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, and black pepper.
Add the sliced pork to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Grill the pork for 5-7 minutes per side, or until charred and cooked through.
Grill the sliced peppers for 3-5 minutes per side, or until charred and tender.
Cook the bun cha noodles according to package instructions.
Assemble the dish by placing the cooked noodles in the tagliere, topping with grilled pork and peppers, and garnishing with chopped cilantro.
Garnish with additional cilantro and peppers if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
